description: As cpu, with Parabricks DeepVariant on 4 GPUs of any type (gpu_type "": the plugin applies the type at submit, so the jobs use every GPU node and the call cache is shared; measured 2026-10-16: 11-12 minutes per sample on a 6-GPU L40S node, 17 on a 4-GPU A100 node, instead of 65 core-hours; six GPUs are no faster, three 2-GPU jobs per node give more samples an hour at 26 minutes each). mem_gb 256 because Parabricks' host memory passes the task's 192 GiB default on deeper samples. Parabricks calls about 10 % fewer indels than CPU DeepVariant, so benchmark against a truth set before production.
